title: Repeat Reinstatements — Paystride Payroll Card Program Risk Desk Ruling
content:
**Ruling.** The reinstatement fee of a Paystride Payroll Card Program is multiplied for repeat reinstatements, counting the reinstatement fees debited in the reinstatement look-back less the reinstatement fees credited in it, the reinstatement look-back holding the funding entries dated today or earlier that lie fewer than twelve whole months before today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the entry's:

1. two or more — by 2.0;
2. exactly one — by 1.5;
3. none — the fee is not multiplied for repeat reinstatements.

**Grounds read.** The reinstatement fees and the credits of reinstatement fees in the program's funding history, each by its own entry date.

### Look-back edge (hypothetical, today being 18 June)

| Reinstatement fee dated | Whole months before today | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 19 June of the previous year | 11 | yes |
| 18 June of the previous year | 12 | no |

### Hypothetical cases

| Reinstatement fees debited in the look-back | Credited in it | Count | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 2.0 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 1.5 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 1.5 |
| 0 | 0 | none | none |

A fee figured at 58.20 multiplied by 1.5 is 87.30, and by 2.0 is 116.40.
